title: Brazilian Paella with Walnut Crust
description: A twist on the classic Spanish dish, this Brazilian paella features a crunchy walnut crust and is packed with flavorful chicken and spices.
instructions: In a blender or food processor, blend chopped walnuts until finely ground.
In a large skillet, heat coconut oil over medium-high heat. Add chicken and cook until browned, about 5 minutes.
Add diced onion and minced garlic to the skillet and cook until the onion is translucent.
Stir in cumin, paprika, salt, and black pepper. Cook for 1 minute.
Add paella rice to the skillet and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Transfer the skillet to the preheated oven and bake for 20-25 minutes, or until the rice is tender and the liquid has been absorbed.
While the paella is baking, mix the ground walnuts with a pinch of salt.
To assemble the paella, remove it from the oven and sprinkle the walnut crust on top.
Return the paella to the oven and bake for an additional 5-10 minutes, or until the crust is golden brown.
Remove the paella from the oven and let it rest for 5 minutes before serving.
